architecture: Original OCT is normalized linearly with joint state, velocity and previous_action. Geometry enters both per-observation geometry tokens (cross-attention alongside vision) and a separate global MLP (AdaLN and temporal attention bias). Vision does not enter the global MLP. The previously quoted 37,632 is flattened visual scalar dimensionality, not a token count; probe feature_dimensions records the measured dimensions. A poor full F_cond ridge readout alone cannot establish visual drowning. The local 7D signed OCT MLP residual enters AdaLN and final modulation only; geometry tokens and temporal-bias conditioning retain the original global vector. stage4 symlog adds residuals to the original linear geometry/global channels.
